title: Aosta Valley to Strasbourg
route: Courmayeur → Great St. Bernard Tunnel → Strasbourg
intro: Leave Courmayeur at 8:30 AM and cross the Great St. Bernard Tunnel into Switzerland, continuing toward Strasbourg without a sightseeing detour. Allow about an hour for lunch along the way, plus fuel and rest stops. Driving time is currently estimated at 5 hours 40 minutes to 7 hours, before stops; arrival depends on traffic and breaks.

stops.name: Courmayeur
stops.description: Leave Courmayeur after two nights beneath Mont Blanc and head east through the Aosta Valley.

stops.name: Great St. Bernard Tunnel
stops.description: Cross beneath the Alps from Italy into Switzerland through the Great St. Bernard Tunnel.

stops.name: Strasbourg
stops.description: Arrive in Strasbourg and settle in for the night in the city's historic center.
